description:
Fetch one message with its full content, parties and mentions.

The answer includes the number's stable `number_id` (`num_…`) next to
`number_alias`.

`at` is when the message actually happened on WhatsApp; `status.at` is
when it reached its current delivery status and keeps moving as receipts
arrive. They answer different questions and are not interchangeable.

Returns not found if the id belongs to a different number. Past the
organization's content retention window (1 hour by default, up to 72
hours depending on the plan) the message is still returned, with
`content_expired` true and its content empty.

message_id.description: Message id (`msg_…`), as returned by a send or by `list_messages`.
message_id.title: Message Id

number_alias.description: Which of the organization's WhatsApp numbers this acts on: `main`, the alias of an extra number, or the number's `id` (`num_…`), which stays the same when the alias is renamed. Call `list_numbers` to see them. Defaults to the main number.
number_alias.title: Number Alias

name: get_message
title: Get one message in full
